newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus prices A340X jets at $140.
newsitem.headline: Airbus prices A340X jets at $140.

text.p: Airbus Industrie put the price tag on the planned new versions of its A340 long-range passenger jets on Monday.
Airbus head of sales John Leahy told reporters at the Paris air show that the company was looking to sell the new A340-500 and A340-600s for around $140 and $150 million apiece.
The four-nation consortium is now seeking launch orders, having announced the $2.5 billion project on Sunday.
By increasing wing size and engine power the A340-600 will have the longest passenger aircraft range in the world, of 8,300 nautical miles, and a 1,000 nautical miles further than the current A340.
The A340-600 will fly the around 7,500 nautical miles but carry 378 passengers, compared to 295 for the current A340 and 313 for the A340-500.
Airbus is launching the plane as a stopgap to compete against Boeing Co's monopoly of the high-capacity segment with its 777 giant twinjet and the 747 jumbo, which seats around 400 passengers.
Airbus wants to launch next year its A3XX 500-seater double-decker but still has to persuade enough airlines to provide sufficient launch orders for the projected $8-billion plus development.
